train.info: Two high-speed train/TGV stations are located near the entry points. The one in Saint-Michel-de-Maurienne/Valloire is about 6 km from Orelle. The Moûtiers - Salins-les-Thermes - Brides-les-Bains station is about the same distance from the gondola in Brides-les-Bains. From the station in Moûtiers, you can continue to the valleys (Courchevel, Méribel, and Les Menuires/Val Thorens) using public transportation.

train.info: Zermatt has a direct train station. Since the village is car-free and can only be reached via the Matterhorn Gotthard Railway, arriving entirely by train is the obvious choice. The nearest train station to Breuil-Cervinia is in Châtillon/Saint-Vincent. Scheduled buses run to the ski area.
